bible.studioSubtitle: Build a deep, evidence-backed Novel Bible before writing, keep it alive as chapters are written, or extract one from an existing novel.
bible.noProject: Open a project to see its Novel Bible.

empty.foundationHint: Create a project with the Novel Intelligence Studio template, or add Story Foundation / Reader Contract / Theme Map cards and generate them.
empty.ledgerHint: Generate the Narrative Architecture card; saving it fans out Plot Threads, Promises, Knowledge Facts, Timeline Events and Relationship Arcs.
empty.relationshipsHint: Relationship Arcs appear here once the Narrative Architecture is saved or the Living Bible proposes them.
empty.knowledgeHint: Knowledge Facts track who knows what. Generate the Narrative Architecture or accept Living Bible updates.
empty.analysisHint: Run the Narrative Reverse-Engineering Lab on an imported manuscript to fill this section.
empty.updatesHint: Open a chapter and use 'Propose Bible updates' in the Extract tab. Proposals appear here for review.

bible.deepenNotes: Optional notes for the deepening (what to emphasise)

updates.title: Bible Update Review
updates.subtitle: Nothing is written to the Bible until you decide. Every change carries evidence, confidence and a truth status.
updates.noPending: No pending decisions for the selected changes.
updates.proposeHint: Analyse this chapter against the Bible and propose reviewable changes (nothing is applied automatically).

context.title: Compiled Bible context
context.hint: The minimum relevant Bible slice injected into chapter generation, with the reason each block was selected.
context.empty: Nothing selected: the Bible has no entries relevant to these participants yet.

lab.title: Narrative Reverse-Engineering Lab
lab.subtitle: Turn a novel you have the right to analyse into an evidence-backed structural Bible, then learn its Narrative Genome and transform it into an original story. Only files you supply are analysed.
lab.dropFile: Drop a TXT, Markdown, EPUB or DOCX file here, or click to choose
lab.author: Author
lab.detected: {included} of {total} chapters included · {words} words · {volumes} volume(s) · pattern: {pattern}
lab.estimate: Estimated analysis input: ~{tokens} tokens across {chapters} chapters
lab.splitPrompt: Paste the first words of the new chapter (the split happens at their first occurrence)
lab.imported: Imported {n} chapters ({words} words), {excluded} sections excluded. Now analyse the manuscript.
lab.runWorkflowHint: Pick the model (AuthND is preselected) and start the Narrative Reverse-Engineering Lab. Progress, errors, cancel and resume are shown here; results appear in the Analysis section.
lab.legacy: The legacy Book Teardown Workflow is still available for comparison.
lab.genomeHint: Once the Narrative Genome card exists, open it and use the 'Lab - Originality Transformation' prompt with an 'Originality Transformation' card to derive original premises.
lab.excludedSummary: Excluded from analysis: {side} side stories, {bonus} bonus/extra stories, {other} other sections ({words} words). Review and override below if needed.
lab.uncertain: {n} section(s) could not be classified and are excluded pending your review.
lab.planSummary: {selected} of {total} chapters selected ({done} done, {failed} failed) → about {calls} model calls, ~{tokens} input tokens

forge.title: Automated Forge Pipeline
forge.subtitle: Import → Analyse → Fingerprint → Foundation → Bible → Outlines → Chapters. Every stage is gated by evidence, isolation and synchronization state; nothing is generated from an incomplete or stale context.
forge.originalCreated: Original project #{id} created (isolated from the source).
forge.noSource: No imported manuscript in this project.
forge.originalNoSource: Original project: the source manuscript stays in the source project. Only the fingerprint and abstract mechanisms were transferred.

blockers.not_original_project: Chapters are generated in an original project only.
blockers.isolation_failed: Source/original isolation failed; fix the contamination first.
blockers.stale_dependencies: Stale dependencies: rebuild the affected artifacts before generating.
blockers.unresolved_errors: Unresolved errors in the manifest block generation.
blockers.run_active: A chapter run is already in progress.
blockers.chapter_not_allowed: Only the next allowed chapter (or a committed chapter) can be generated.
